negatives.failure: A combined status-and-source scan exceeded its bounded timeout before returning output.
negatives.recovery: Retain the timeout and split the read into exact bounded probes under a non-login shell.

negatives.failure: A standalone ordinary Git status probe exceeded its sixty-second bound without output.
negatives.recovery: Award no clean-state credit and use exact index, tracked-diff, and untracked-path primitives.

negatives.failure: A login-shell sequence of exact Git primitives exceeded its bounded timeout.
negatives.recovery: Change only the shell invocation mode and rerun the exact split primitives.

negatives.failure: A read-only process query exceeded its bounded timeout without usable output.
negatives.recovery: Discard the result and prove minimal shell responsiveness without changing process or host state.

negatives.failure: The Method Flow summary wrote derived files but its final console print failed under the default Windows code page on Māori text.
negatives.recovery: Retain the failed print, rerun the same summary under explicit Python UTF-8 mode, and revalidate the ledger.

negatives.failure: A general environment-directory enumeration exceeded its bounded timeout without output.
negatives.recovery: Use a path-scoped repository file-index query and retain the failed enumeration.

negatives.failure: The first closeout detailed validator ran all 75 scoped tests but failed an evidence-test assumption that every method has exactly one failed witness.
negatives.recovery: Retain the failed receipt and replace only the invalid exact-cardinality assertion with balanced parity and at-least-one-per-method guards.

negatives.failure: The inherited per-path staged reviewer exceeded its 180-second bound before a completed review was acknowledged.
negatives.recovery: Retain the timeout and batch exact stage-zero Git-blob reads through communicate without changing the hash or privacy domain.

negatives.failure: The optimized staged reviewer rejected one private absolute traceback path in the retained failed validator receipt.
negatives.recovery: Preserve the failed test and assertion while replacing only the private location prefix, then rerun the identical five-class scan.

negatives.failure: The first stale-label wrapper had a pre-execution nested-quoting syntax error and scanned no files.
negatives.recovery: Retain the parser fault and compare exact path and literal arrays with PowerShell simple-match semantics.

negatives.failure: A closeout test found two new Method Flow witness paths absent from the prior owner-manifest path set.
negatives.recovery: Retain the failed test, stage the complete now-known surface, rebuild the exact owner manifest, and rerun the unchanged test.
